ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.description: [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card until the end of combat. Attacks gain [blue]2[/blue] [purple]Laced[/purple]; Skills gain [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Fuming[/purple]; Powers gain [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Exalted[/purple]. Other cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].

ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description: A card with [gold]Reaction[/gold] gains an extra effect when the card played directly before it matches.

ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.exhaust: When you play this card directly after a card that [gold]Exhausted[/gold], it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.power: When you play this card directly after playing a Power, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.skill: When you play this card directly after playing a Skill, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
